_note: Episode 3 version 2 (the new form). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py); 'full' holds each still's JSON prompt (subject, setting, light) from /opt/work/bk/ep03v2/plan.json, 'draw' is null until a draw is chosen. Shot N is still bk_{N-1}. Writing in pictures is added in code after the choice: bk_09 the plaque, bk_50 the episode's question, bk_39 the Acta pages as plain lines. Silent shots are shown inside a neighbouring sentence through a 'keys' montage in shots_fx.json: shot 33 (the vendor weighs him, bk_32) is key 90 inside sentence 71; shot 36 (the hand on the sill, bk_35) is key 91 inside sentence 77, the line that tells it; shot 42 (hats in the sky, bk_41) is key 92 inside sentence 85, after the shout. Shot 52 (the trivia card) uses the existing layout and has no still. Camera moves and their reasons are in shots_fx.json ("why"), chosen by pipeline/CAMERA.md.
